minutes_text:
MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  City Council, Community Development Agency,
  Community Development Financing Authority,
  Public Improvement Corporation,
  and Library Board of Trustees*
  Adjourned Meeting/Workshop
  June 30, 2008

An Adjourned Meeting/Workshop of the City Council, the Community Development Agency,
the Community Development Financing Authority, the Public Improvement Corporation, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Mayor
Kelley at 5:01 pm, on June 30, 2008, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo, California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on June 27, 2008, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at the Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and the
Norman P. Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Mayor Kelley
  Mayor Pro Tem Ury
  Council Member Ledesma
  Council Member MacLean
  Council Member Reavis

Absent:  None

Staff Present:  Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  Irwin Bornstein, Asst. City Manager/Director of Administrative Services
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Karen Hamman, City Clerk

INVOCATION: Council Member MacLean

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Reavis

CLOSED SESSION

Conference with City Attorney Concerning One Matter of Existing Litigation Pursuant to
Government Code Section 54956.9(a). The Litigation is Jose Guadalupe Gomez Mejia;
Orange County Community Housing Corporation; Public Law Center v. City of Mission
Viejo; Case Status Update

City Council Workshop Minutes  1  June 30, 2008
 Public Employee Performance Evaluation of the Incumbent for the Position of City
Manager Pursuant to Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 5:03 p.m., Mayor Kelley recessed the meeting to Closed Session. The City
Council reconvened at 6:08 p.m., with three Council Members present. Mayor Pro Tem Ury and
Council Member Reavis joined the meeting at 6:09 p.m.

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that the City Council received direction for Closed Session
item CS1 but there was no reportable action. The City Council will address the matter of CS2 at
the end of the open session meeting tonight.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Stuart Jasper, M.V.: discussed chronic nuisance problems in his neighborhood and stated that he
is pleased to report that members of city staff are beginning to make progress.

CONSENT CALENDAR

  Motion made by Council Member MacLean, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to approve
  the Consent Calendar as described below.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  1.  City of Mission Viejo Pavement Management Program: Year 2008 Update

  Received and filed.

NEW BUSINESS

  2.  City Council Communication with Auditors

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein
  announced that the City’s Auditor has not yet arrived and if the Council so desires,
  the matter can be deferred to a later time in the evening to allow for the Auditor to be
  present.

  3.  Adoption of FY 2008-09 Budget for the Mission Viejo Community Development
  Financing Authority

City Council Workshop Minutes  2  June 30, 2008
   Treasury Manager Josephine Julian presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Ledesma, seconded by Council Member
  MacLean, to adopt CDFA Resolution 2008-01 Adopting a Budget for the Mission
  Viejo Community Development Financing Authority for the 2008-09 Fiscal Year.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  4.  Revised FY 2008-09 Mission Viejo Community Development Agency Budget

  Treasury Manager Josephine Julian presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, seconded by Council Member Ledesma, to
  adopt CDA Resolution 08-03 Adopting a Revised Budget for the Community
  Development Agency of the City of Mission Viejo for FY 2008-09.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  5.  Revised FY 2008-09 City Budget

  City Manager Dennis Wilberg presented the staff report.

  Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: expressed concern with staff's recommended changes to
  capital projects and deletion of a program objective relating to an audit of SCE. Ms.
  Schlicht reiterated her prior request for EMF warning signs in City parks.

  Motion made by Council Member Ledesma to (1) approve Resolution 08-XX,
  Adopting a Revised Budget for the City of Mission Viejo for FY 2008-09 and
  appropriating funds for FY 2008-09; (2) approve Resolution 08-XX, Establishing an
  Appropriations Limit for FY 2008-09; and (3) approve Resolution 08-XX, Amending
  the City’s Salary Schedule to Adjust One Existing Classification and to Add Two
  New Classifications. Motion died for lack of a second.

  Motion made by Council Member MacLean, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to (1)
  approve Resolution 08-37, Adopting a Revised Budget for the City of Mission Viejo
  for FY 2008-09 and Appropriating Funds for FY 2008-09; (2) approve Resolution
  08-38, Establishing an Appropriations Limit for FY 2008-09; (3) approve Resolution
  08-39, Amending the City’s Salary Schedule to Adjust One Existing Classification
  and to Add Two New Classifications; and (4) direct staff to return with information
  outlining costs and options for inclusion of the following projects in the FY 2008-
City Council Workshop Minutes  3  June 30, 2008
   2009 budget: (a) two playground renovation projects, (b) the Montanoso Recreation
  Center locker room project and (c) the Marguerite Tennis Center renovation project.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  RECESS

  At the hour of 7:54 p.m., Mayor Kelley declared a recess. The City Council reconvened
  at 8:07 p.m. with all five City Council Members present.

  6.  Authorization for Preliminary FY 2007-08 Carryovers

  Budget and Research Manager Nancy Livingston presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, seconded by Council Member Ledesma, to
  adopt Resolution 08-40, Authorizing, on an Interim Basis, the Carryover of FY
  2007-08 Year-end Encumbrances and Periodic Adjustments to the FY 2008-09
  Budget to Reflect Encumbered FY 2007-08 Balances Until FY 2007-08 Spending is
  Closed.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

  2.  City Council Communication with Auditors (Continued)

  Assistant City Manager/Director of Administrative Services Irwin Bornstein stated
  that the City’s auditor was unable to attend the meeting and the Council can either
  defer the item or act upon it based on the written report presented in the Agenda
  materials.

  Motion made by Council Member Ledesma, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Ury, to
  receive correspondence from Diehl, Evans & Company, LLP, the City’s independent
  auditors, regarding the upcoming financial statement audit for the fiscal year ending
  June 30, 2008, and determine that the City is in agreement.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

City Council Workshop Minutes  4  June 30, 2008
 STAFF REPORTS

  7.  Memorandum of Understanding Regarding Aliso Viejo Transfer of Rule 20A
  Funds

  City Manager Dennis Wilberg presented the staff report.

  Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: asked questions about the Rule 20A funds and stated that she
  hopes Mission Viejo will not incur any expenses on the proposed transaction.

  Motion made by Council Member MacLean, seconded by Council Member Reavis,
  to authorize execution of the Memorandum of Understanding with Aliso Viejo.
  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Kelley, Ledesma, MacLean, Reavis, and Ury
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION AND RECONVENE

At the hour of 8:29 p.m., Mayor Kelley recessed the meeting to Closed Session.

Council Member Reavis departed at 8:33 p.m. and did not return before the end of the meeting.

The City Council reconvened in open session at 10:13 p.m. with four City Council Members
present (Council Member Reavis was absent).

REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

City Attorney Bill Curley announced that there was no reportable action from Closed Session for
Item CS2.

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 10:15 p.m., there being no further business to come before the City Council at this
session, Mayor Kelley adjourned the meeting to Monday, July 7, 2008, at 5:00 p.m.

______________________________________________
Karen Hamman, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of August 18, 2008

City Council Workshop Minutes  5  June 30, 2008
